content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

The limitations imposed by conventional payment platforms often hinder digital creators from monetizing their products effectively. Platforms like Gumroad charge steep fees, taking up to 10% from each sale, while NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This significant difference means that for creators making 100 sales per month at $97 each, they would retain an additional $921. By utilizing a sovereign stack, you bypass the limitations of these platforms, ensuring that you keep more of your hard-earned revenue.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your infrastructure, gather the necessary tools: a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting your site, a NOWPayments account for accepting Bitcoin, and Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend automation. You will also need a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery and an order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets. Ensure you have your ebook files ready for upload and product descriptions prepared. This preparation sets the stage for a seamless deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by creating your product listings using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate NOWPayments to handle Bitcoin transactions, ensuring that your checkout process is smooth and efficient. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery of your ebooks upon payment confirmation. This setup guarantees that once a transaction is completed, your customer receives their digital product instantly, eliminating delays and enhancing customer satisfaction.
Keep 99.5% of your revenue with NOWPayments' low transaction fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live, ensure that your website is fully functional and your payment integration is tested. Navigate to your GitHub or Cloudflare Pages URL and perform a test transaction using Bitcoin. Monitor the transaction process to verify that payments are processed correctly and that ebooks are delivered as expected. Once the test is successful, promote your sales link to your audience. This initial transaction is crucial for building confidence in your new system and for gathering feedback.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial sales, focus on scaling your operations. Use analytics to track sales performance and customer engagement. You can add more products or diversify your offerings by creating templates or courses. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides you with additional blueprints and templates to enhance your digital store. As your sales grow, consider optimizing your backend processes for better efficiency, ensuring your infrastructure can handle increased traffic and sales volume.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Automated delivery ensures your customers get their products instantly.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can sell an ebook online by utilizing NOWPayments for Bitcoin transactions. Set up a website using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your product. Automate the delivery process using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for a seamless customer experience.

The most effective way to sell digital downloads without high platform fees is by using a sovereign commerce stack. This allows you to retain control over your sales and keep more revenue by leveraging tools like NOWPayments, which has a minimal fee structure.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without relying on Gumroad or Payhip by setting up your own digital store. Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for accepting Bitcoin, allowing direct transactions with your customers.
What are the key benefits of using a sovereign commerce stack?

A sovereign commerce stack offers complete ownership of your digital products, lower fees compared to traditional platforms, and no dependency on external services. This architecture provides a sustainable long-term solution for digital creators.
How can I automate the delivery of my digital products?

Automate delivery of your digital products by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. These tools allow you to send files automatically to customers once payment is confirmed, enhancing efficiency and customer satisfaction.
